questions.stem: How did carbon become locked up in fossil fuels millions of years ago?

options.text: Animals breathed carbon into the ground
Dead organisms were buried and compressed over millions of years without decomposing fully
The carbon cycle did not exist millions of years ago

questions.explanation: Millions of years ago, dead organisms were buried under layers of sediment before they could fully decompose. Over time, heat and pressure converted their carbon-containing remains into fossil fuels like coal, oil, and gas.
